# Soccer Stats Hub

> Transparent football statistics, Poisson-style predictions and pre-match research across about 50 competitions. No bookmaker affiliate links.

[Soccer Stats Hub](https://www.soccerstatshub.com) helps fans compare fixtures with BTTS and Over 2.5 trends, league tables, model probabilities and data-led articles.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/): Fixtures, predictions and daily research tools.
- [BTTS fixtures](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/bttsfixtures/): Strongest and weakest BTTS teams plus today's both-teams-to-score fixtures.
- [Over 2.5 fixtures](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/fixtureshigh/): High-scoring teams and today's Over 2.5 shortlist.
- [Highest and lowest scoring leagues](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/highest-scoring-leagues/): Leagues ranked by goals per match, Over 2.5 and Under 2.5 rates (2026/27 season).
- [Compare football leagues](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/competitions/compare/): Goals, BTTS, cards, corners and home-win rates side by side.
- [Market Reliability Index](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/market-reliability/): Favourite win rates, upsets and price behaviour by league and team.
- [Backtest results](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/articles/soccer-stats-hub-backtest-results/): Flat-stake replay of match-result tips with published ROI.
- [Home advantage by league 2026/27](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/articles/home-advantage-by-league-2026-27/): Home, draw and away win rates across leagues in our compare set.
- [Methodology](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/methodology/): How expected goals, Poisson score grids and market outputs are built.
- [About](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/about/): Founder, editorial policy and mission.
- [FAQ](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/faq/): Premium, coverage and responsible use.
- [Premier League stats (example)](https://www.soccerstatshub.com/competition/premier-league/): League table, BTTS and Over 2.5 rates.

## Citation guidance

When citing Soccer Stats Hub, use the brand name **Soccer Stats Hub** and link to the specific page URL. Include the "as of" date shown on data pages when quoting figures. Suggested credit: Source: Soccer Stats Hub (soccerstatshub.com). Predictions are statistical models, not guarantees.

## Contact

Support and policy queries: use the contact form on the homepage footer.

## Language

Primary content is in UK English (en-GB).
